user_preferences.preference: Prefers HSL colors, modern dark OLED/glassmorphism aesthetics, Google Fonts (Inter, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans), smooth micro-animations, and clean layout blueprints.
Demands production-level, well-written, clean codebase architecture with zero over-engineering and strict surgical changes.
ALWAYS run real-time GitHub repo scouting via repo-scout / auto-scout tools when building new features to discover newly trending state-of-the-art libraries, design patterns, and tools automatically.

project_rules.rule: Always query live GitHub scouting before introducing new dependencies or building complex UI/Auth/DevOps components.
